name: Mitsuki
source:
Coming from the countryside, her parents own a farm, where she was raised and would usually help out. Mitsuki has a bit of a complex when it comes to her upbringing, having always dreamed of the wonders of the city. She's naive and easily fooled, so she doesn't take being teased or deceived very well. Her main reason for becoming a hostess was to overcome her shyness and to get better at talking with men, who she's usually extra shy around.

[spoiler]Her real name is Oochi Megumi (大地 恵).[/spoiler]
